validation.evidence: 40 tests, 0 failures; covers the compose descriptor/result, normalized primary and attached-email identity, default and explicit audiences, fresh authorization and access errors, exact interests, both primary-email eligibility directions, participant entry/exit, isolation, and the accepted Membership participant-read contract.

notes: Added the :member_message_compose descriptor on :compose_context with stable club_id, optional group_id, and authenticated_email inputs. Every load normalizes identity, rereads active clubs, resolves Person plus active selected-club membership by Person ID, rereads current participation, and reads all selected-group participants once; count filters non-nil primary emails only after exact Person and Person-email interests are derived for every participant. The exact result keys are selected_club, current_member, audience_group, active_member_count, and message_audience; tests preserve default forbidden versus explicit not_found semantics, singular/plural presentation, eligibility loss/gain, represented-interest replacement, and unrelated identity isolation. The initial TDD run failed as expected with 7 tests and 7 failures because the query module was not yet present. No LiveView wiring, adapter, package, Membership API, authoritative recipient resolution, projector, schema, command, event, plan, todo, matrix, ADR, or acceptance feature changed; task 008D2 remains unchecked.
